maddeler.e:
نرتعب (form VIII)
# نَرْتَعِبُ (nartaʕibu) /nar.ta.ʕi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# نَرْتَعِبَ (nartaʕiba) /nar.ta.ʕi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# نَرْتَعِبْ (nartaʕib) /nar.ta.ʕib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
